subject: Activation calendar & MAP — LumenWorks onboarding: timeline, owners, dependencies
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: sarah@lumenworks.com
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation calendar & MAP — LumenWorks onboarding: timeline, owners, dependencies

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time this week. Per our call, I put together a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) and an activation calendar that lays out milestones, owners, and a few open dependencies so we have a single source of truth for the next six weeks. Key things inside:

- Kickoff (technical & project) dates and required attendees
- Short-term deliverables (API keys, test dataset upload, onboarding test plan)
- Owner roster (Redwood and LumenWorks owners by task)
- SLA exception request for initial burst traffic (draft attached)

Can you confirm the dates below work for your team? If you prefer, we can move the technical kickoff to the 25th instead of the 24th. I attached the MAP (spreadsheet) and activation checklist.

Proposed highlights (week-of):
- Aug 24: Project kickoff (product + infra) — owners: laura_bennett, david.park
- Aug 26: API keys & test data ingestion complete — owners: connor_obrien, sarah
- Sep 1: First validation run + quality review — owners: monica_patel, david
- Sep 7: Production cutover window (low-traffic) — owners: marcus_lin, LumenWorks infra

Open dependency: LumenWorks to confirm SOC 2 evidence for data classification (we can accept the summary report).

Next steps: please confirm the kickoff date and whether tech kickoff on Aug 24 or 25 is better.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: LumenWorks_MAP_v1.xlsx, activation-checklist.pdf
From: sarah@lumenworks.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: david.park@lumenworks.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation calendar & MAP — LumenWorks onboarding: timeline, owners, dependencies

Laura —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. The dates look good overall. Quick notes:

- We prefer the tech kickoff on Aug 25 (seems easier for our infra team).
- I'll own SOC 2 evidence collection and aim to share a summary by Aug 23.
- David will handle test dataset prep; he asked if you have a preferred S3 bucket layout or presigned-upload flow.

I'll confirm internally and send any edits by EOD Friday.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Data Engineering | LumenWorks
sarah@lumenworks.com | +1 503-555-4122

Thanks — keeping this short.

We can provision a temporary test S3 bucket and provide presigned PUTs for the dataset. Connor will send a short how-to and sample IAM policy ahead of the tech kickoff. Action items assigned:

- Connor O'Brien: share S3 presigned/upload instructions + sample IAM by Aug 20
- Monica Patel: verify test data schema and write the validation checklist by Aug 26

I'll also add a row in the MAP for data retention settings and TTL expectations (we should confirm with LumenWorks on retention class).

-Connor

Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0190

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation calendar & MAP — LumenWorks onboarding: timeline, owners, dependencies

All —

Quick check-in ahead of the kickoff: I reviewed the dataset sample David sent (thanks, David). A couple of observations:

- There are a handful of free-text fields that will need normalization (we can document mappings in the validation checklist).
- Suggested schema change: add a uuid field for traceability (recommended by infra).

I'm attaching the validation checklist (activation-checklist.pdf) and a short comment column in the MAP spreadsheet. If LumenWorks can add the uuid and normalize two fields, we should be green for the Aug 26 validation run.

Also, Marcus — can you confirm capacity for the low-traffic cutover window on Sep 7? I want to ensure we have the reserved pool available.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Technical Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0177

Hi team —

Confirmed: reserved test capacity is scheduled for Sep 7 (AWS us-west-2 reserved pool). I'll add the reservation ID into the MAP. FYI, the SLA exception request is fine for initial burst; we should finalize the exact tokenization limits in the doc but no blocker on the date.

Sarah — looking forward to the tech kickoff on Aug 25; Connor, Monica — I'll be on the call to validate capacity and run the brief smoke tests.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
